headline: Losses are stop-volume + universe dilution, amplified by £100k sizing — not a broken hour-15 filter on the original top-10.

root_causes.title: Stop mass overwhelms take-profits

evidence.60d: 39 stops (−£9.3k) vs 8 TPs (+£2.1k); need ~36 TPs to offset, had 8

root_causes.severity: Hour-15 engulfing still rare; expanding names multiplies false breakouts that hit the 1R-padded stop.

root_causes.title: Edge is top-10; rest_30 and banks/fin/defence destroy it
root_causes.implication: v2.2 was tuned on megacap top-10; mid-cap / bank / defence names are net negative under the same rules.

root_causes.title: Win rate below breakeven despite decent payoff

evidence.120d: WR 23.8% vs breakeven ~25.2% (payoff 2.97) — tiny gap, still red

root_causes.implication: Longer windows improve payoff (bigger TPs) but stop count grows faster than TPs.

root_causes.title: £100k + 1.5%/35% sizing amplifies every stop; SDRT is material

evidence.note: Same risk fraction as £20k book → ~5× pound P&L per trade. One III.L stop alone −£1,463.

root_causes.implication: Costs (~£2–5k SDRT across windows) are same order as the book loss; each false breakout pays 0.5% again.

root_causes.title: 60d loss is front-loaded
root_causes.implication: Same pattern as prior top-10 v2.1 60d (bad first half); cooloff/max_stops help but do not remove early chop on new names.

root_causes.title: max_stops=2 still leaves many double-stop symbols on 90/120d
root_causes.implication: Cap limits damage per name but with 50 names, 30×2 stops still dominate.

not_root_causes: Hour-15 filter broken on top-10 (top-10 cohort still +£293 on 60d / +£1.5k on 90d)
Tiny risk geometry (median stop distance ~2%, not sub-1% noise)
Missing data (50/50 symbols healthy all windows)
fix_levers_ranked: Keep universe narrow (top-10 or liquid staples/energy only) — largest lever
Sector / name blacklist: banks, defence, volatile fin (III) under this setup
Lower risk_frac or max_position_frac at £100k so one stop ≠ −£1k+
Stricter max_stops (1) or longer cooloff on broad books
Cost gate already on; consider requiring larger pattern range before entry on mid-caps
